facts.text: Forest Hills pancakes (Aunt May's Forest Hills kitchen, with syrup)
facts.why: The film is set in Queens and used a house on a Forest Hills street as Peter and Aunt May's home, which matches the comics' Forest Hills address.

vibe.verdict: Right diner, right waitress, and the Bone Saw wrestling night and upside-down kiss are all in, so a fan will grin.
missing: Uncle Ben, 'With great power comes great responsibility' (end)
Green Goblin glider and pumpkin bombs (Unity Day festival)
Tram full of kids on the Queensboro Bridge
Peter's spider bite at the Columbia lab
Daily Bugle 'Green Goblin' headline from Jameson
ideas: Swap the Free Coffee coupon for a Bugle 'Green Goblin' front page coupon.
Replace 'Egg cream' note with 'Peter's lab bite, no refunds'.
Add a Queensboro Bridge tram sticker next to the Bugle cherry rickey.
Swap the stock 'Western omelette' for a Thanksgiving Blue Plate special sign pointing at the Osborn dinner.
